Component Test Reports & API Documentation

These are the reports Kronikol draws from Breakfast Provider's component tests: each scenario's HTTP calls, database queries and messages as a sequence diagram. See one.

Test Run Reports

Every report reads the last runs of its lane from the cross-run history ledger: a sparkline and verdict beside each scenario, a History section beside the timeline, and $flaky in the search box. Each report folder also carries Failures.md and ctrf-report.json.
